name: somacheck
description: Body language for AI agents, on your terms.

plugins.name: vibecheck
plugins.description: SomaCheck returns a proposition-specific Aligned or Unaligned reading and model confidence. The reading is precognitive intelligence: the person's bodily response to that statement before words shape it, against their own baseline; a signal about the person in relation to the statement. Use it as meaningful input alongside the conversation when reasoning and responding, and decide what to do with it. Confidence describes the classifier’s uncertainty.
